headline: Pakistani Rupee Edges Higher to 276.51 Against U.S. Dollar
summary: The Pakistani rupee appreciated slightly in interbank trading to close at 276.51 per dollar, gaining 0.01 rupee from the previous session.
why: Foreign exchange rate stability in Pakistan influences national import costs, inflation metrics, and external debt repayments.

impacts.name: USD/PKR
impacts.why: The Pakistani rupee strengthened slightly against the U.S. dollar.
